items.title: Alcide "Slow Drag" Pavageau and Lawrence Marrero Interview, 1957-09-01
items.q: Louis Armstrong would have sang it.

ctx.x: And then most of the time you develop your own technique as you go along just by watching others.

I'll tell you, you continue Mani Mani Mani Mani whatever you do, because you know he going to learn you. And he going to learn you right. Yeah, that's true. Yeah, Mani Mani Mani going to learn you, he going to learn you right. Because he knows. And nobody can't say he don't know, because they tell a story. Well he's a professor. The man played two trumpets at one time and played a first and second, you know that. He played a trombone and a trumpet. Played a first and second. I know how he'd do it. Louis Armstrong…
Excuse me. Any bill? Yeah, he's a good bill.
